bookings_unpaid_coaching_starts_idx.name: bookings_unpaid_coaching_starts_idx
bookings_unpaid_coaching_starts_idx.where: "bookings"."coaching_client_id" is not null and "bookings"."credit_covered_at" is null and "bookings"."status" = 'confirmed'

bookings_guest_email_length.name: bookings_guest_email_length
bookings_guest_email_length.value: ("bookings"."guest_email" is null and "bookings"."coaching_client_id" is not null) or ("bookings"."guest_email" is not null and char_length("bookings"."guest_email") between 3 and 254)

bookings_coaching_series.name: bookings_coaching_series
bookings_coaching_series.value: "bookings"."coaching_series_id" is null or "bookings"."coaching_client_id" is not null

bookings_coaching_terms.name: bookings_coaching_terms
bookings_coaching_terms.value:
("bookings"."coaching_client_id" is null and "bookings"."credit_period_id" is null and "bookings"."credit_units" is null
       and "bookings"."credit_notice_hours" is null and "bookings"."credit_late_cancellation" is null
       and "bookings"."credit_cancellation_outcome" is null and "bookings"."attended_at" is null)
      or ("bookings"."coaching_client_id" is not null and "bookings"."credit_period_id" is not null and "bookings"."booking_page_id" is null
       and "bookings"."payment_status" = 'not_required' and "bookings"."price_cents" is null
       and "bookings"."credit_units" is not null and "bookings"."credit_units" between 1 and 100000
       and "bookings"."credit_notice_hours" is not null and "bookings"."credit_notice_hours" between 0 and 720
       and "bookings"."credit_late_cancellation" is not null and "bookings"."credit_late_cancellation" in ('preserve', 'forfeit')
       and (("bookings"."status" = 'confirmed' and "bookings"."credit_cancellation_outcome" is null)
         or ("bookings"."status" = 'cancelled' and "bookings"."attended_at" is null and "bookings"."credit_cancellation_outcome" is not null
           and "bookings"."credit_cancellation_outcome" in ('released', 'forfeited'))))

businesses_reservation_hours.name: businesses_reservation_hours
businesses_reservation_hours.value:
("businesses"."payment_reminder_hours" is null or "businesses"."payment_reminder_hours" between 1 and 720)
      and ("businesses"."unpaid_cancellation_hours" is null or "businesses"."unpaid_cancellation_hours" between 1 and 720)
      and "businesses"."payment_reminder_hours" > "businesses"."unpaid_cancellation_hours"

client_guardians_contact.name: client_guardians_contact
client_guardians_contact.value: ("client_guardians"."email" is not null or "client_guardians"."phone" is not null) and char_length(coalesce("client_guardians"."email", '')) <= 254 and char_length(coalesce("client_guardians"."phone", '')) <= 40

coaching_packages_term.name: coaching_packages_term
coaching_packages_term.value: ("coaching_packages"."kind" = 'fixed' and "coaching_packages"."term_weeks" is not null and "coaching_packages"."term_weeks" between 1 and 260) or ("coaching_packages"."kind" = 'monthly' and "coaching_packages"."term_weeks" is null)

coaching_packages_installments.name: coaching_packages_installments
coaching_packages_installments.value:
("coaching_packages"."installment_count" is null and "coaching_packages"."installment_cadence" is null) or
    ("coaching_packages"."kind" = 'fixed' and "coaching_packages"."installment_count" is not null and "coaching_packages"."installment_count" between 2 and 24
     and "coaching_packages"."installment_cadence" is not null and "coaching_packages"."installment_cadence" in ('weekly', 'monthly')
     and "coaching_packages"."price_cents" >= "coaching_packages"."installment_count")

coaching_packages_formats.name: coaching_packages_formats
coaching_packages_formats.value:
case when jsonb_typeof("coaching_packages"."session_formats") = 'array' then
      jsonb_array_length("coaching_packages"."session_formats") between 1 and 10 and not jsonb_path_exists(
        "coaching_packages"."session_formats",
        '$[*] ? (@.type() != "object" || !exists(@.name) || @.name.type() != "string" || @.name == "" || !exists(@.durationMinutes) || @.durationMinutes.type() != "number" || @.durationMinutes < 1 || @.durationMinutes > 480 || @.durationMinutes != @.durationMinutes.floor() || !exists(@.creditUnits) || @.creditUnits.type() != "number" || @.creditUnits < 1 || @.creditUnits > $allowance || @.creditUnits != @.creditUnits.floor())',
        jsonb_build_object('allowance', "coaching_packages"."credit_units")
      ) else false end

coaching_packages_coach_ids.name: coaching_packages_coach_ids
coaching_packages_coach_ids.value: "coaching_packages"."eligible_coach_ids" is null or (cardinality("coaching_packages"."eligible_coach_ids") between 1 and 200 and array_position("coaching_packages"."eligible_coach_ids", null) is null)

workspace_subscriptions_stripe_id.name: workspace_subscriptions_stripe_id
workspace_subscriptions_stripe_id.value: ("workspace_subscriptions"."source" = 'stripe') = ("workspace_subscriptions"."stripe_subscription_id" is not null) and ("workspace_subscriptions"."stripe_subscription_id" is null or "workspace_subscriptions"."stripe_subscription_id" ~ '^sub_[A-Za-z0-9]+$')
